props.name: participants
props.description: Everyone in the call, in display order.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the list of tiles.

props.name: activeSpeakerId
props.description: The participant currently speaking. Their tile gets the accent ring.

props.name: pinnedId
props.description: Controlled spotlight. Null or undefined shows the grid.

props.name: onPinnedChange
props.description: Called with the participant pinned, or null when unpinned.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width over height of a tile. 16 / 9 matches most cameras.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Give the component a height here.
